commenti.body:
Is this a joke?

This must be a first year piece of work and if it is summative would be worth a small percentage of the grade.

Furthermore, the directions have clearly laid out everything to be considered.

If you can't handle this one then you are really going to struggle with the paper side of whatever course you are on.

This isn't hard to do. This is basic writing about film - analyse the scene and what you think the elements of production and design are doing to help tell the story or hinder it.

This is an important exercise as you need to start approaching media with an analytical eye. There isn't really much else that can be used to properly assess your understanding on a uni course about film.

Even if you have practical work you'll have to write reflective analysis about what worked and didn't work throughout production to the final edit.
You want someone else to do your work for you? Lazy tosser. Wouldn’t it be nice if your teacher was on this board and saw this and kicked you off your course. Sorry but this really pushed my buttons.

Are college students this incapable of thinking for themselves?

The assignment is basically spoon fed to them with three areas to consider, add in the introduction and conclusion paragraphs and 500 words is easy.

It would be a real shame if someone took this post and forwarded it to a dean at Simon Fraser University, as it is textbook academic dishonesty and would, in many cases, result in a failing grade for the course and a black mark on a student’s record. A real shame that would be.
